question: A _______ is a vertical blinking line in a text editor that indicates the place where anything that is typed will appear.
solution:
The correct answer is __**cursor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **cursor** is a **position indicator** on a computer display **screen** where a user can **enter text**.
 
• The cursor is also a **visible** and **moving pointer** that the **user controls** with a **mouse, touch pad, or similar input device**.
 
• The position of the cursor** ****informs users** of the **mouse operations** that can be **performed at the location**.
 
• The cursor has many** functions** including:
 
 
• **Text selection, **
 
• **Context menus,**
 
• **Copying content, **
 
• **Resizing tables and so on**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Layout**
 
 
 
• The layout is the process of calculating **documents, images, or texts** to make them **appealing to the viewer**.
 
 
 
 

 **Header**
 
 
 
• The **header** is an area **top of a word document** and are **used** for **introductory contains** such as the **author's name, title, file name, dates, page number, etc**.
 
 
 
 

 **Footer**
 
 
 
• **Footers** appear at the **bottom margin** of the **word document** and contain information like **Page numbers, dates, footnotes, etc**.
